_maxAttributionRadiusTilesSource: BUG-847 rework (2026-09-09): caps webconsole/src/sim/trafficDemand.ts's nearestSegmentWeights multi-source BFS radius so cost is bounded by the MAP (grid.ts MAP_W=624 x MAP_H=368, max possible Manhattan diameter 992 tiles) and this figure, never by the city's own occupied bounding-box diameter -- the BUG-847 finding measured 5.12M BFS ops from ONE 400-tile-distant outpost building because the old radius WAS the bbox diameter. 250 tiles = 12.5km at webconsoleMetresPerTile's 50m/tile, a generous upper bound on any plausible road/rail catchment for this game's city scale (the OS Terrain 50 Folkestone start tile is a fraction of that); tiles further than this from every segment of a class report as UNATTRIBUTED demand (forecastUnattributedOf) rather than being silently dropped or paying the old unbounded flood cost.
